# `Browser.Fullscreen`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Fullscreen — request/exit fullscreen and receive change
notifications, over `Ipe.Ffi.Js` ports.

A first-party proof of the per-capability web mechanism spanning BOTH port
directions: an outbound `JsCmd` requests or exits fullscreen or watches for
changes, and an inbound `JsMsg` carries the outcome or a change event. Both
cross the same seal codec and fail-closed port discipline as every other port;
there is no second transport.

Importing this reserved `Ipe.Browser.<Api>` module discloses
`js-port:fullscreen` (import-derived, keyed on the canonical
`Ipe.Browser.Fullscreen` path prefix via `WebCapability::for_browser_module`,
alias-immune); only the top-level app's `[capabilities] accepts` set can grant
it.

The two layers:

  * `Ipe.Browser.Fullscreen.Internals` publishes the closed outbound/inbound ADTs.
  * this module is the high-level layer: `request` and `exit` are one-shot
    `Task Error ()`; `watch` starts a change stream as an outbound `Cmd`, and
    `changes` is the inbound subscription. The inbound `case` is EXHAUSTIVE:
    an unavailability becomes a typed `Err`, never a silently dropped frame.

## `request`

```ipe
request : Task Error ()
```

`request` — ask the browser to enter fullscreen mode for the document
element, as a `Task Error ()`.

Uses the correlated port→Task bridge (`Js.request`). Resolves with `Ok ()`
when the browser enters fullscreen; resolves with a typed `Err` when the
browser refuses (e.g. not triggered by a user gesture) or the API is absent.

Importing this module discloses `js-port:fullscreen`; the app must grant it
with `accepts = [ JsPort Fullscreen ]` under [capabilities] in package.ipe.

## `exit`

```ipe
exit : Task Error ()
```

`exit` — ask the browser to leave fullscreen mode, as a `Task Error ()`.

Resolves with `Ok ()` when fullscreen exits; resolves with a typed `Err` when
the API is absent.

## `watch`

```ipe
watch : Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`watch` — begin a `fullscreenchange` event stream; each change delivers a
fresh state on the `changes` subscription. Outbound `Cmd`.

## `changes`

```ipe
changes : (Result Error Bool -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`changes toMsg` — the inbound subscription, wired in `subscriptions`.

The decoder IS the security gate: every inbound value runs through the total,
bounded seal decoder for the narrow `JsMsg`; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is folded EXHAUSTIVELY into a
`Result Error Bool` — `True` when the document is now in fullscreen mode,
`False` when it has exited.
